criteria.text: Plain up remains a returning background launch, while up --foreground reports the same readiness and keeps its non-interactive launcher alive until down stops the sandbox.
criteria.test_id: preserves plain up as a returning background launch; reliably keeps the launcher alive until down completes its acknowledged stop

criteria.text: Under a non-interactive foreground launcher, the real API on 4098 and engine on 4097 remain alive and both API health endpoints remain successful after readiness.
criteria.test_id: holds real API/engine health, preserves protected listeners, refuses unrelated PIDs, and tears down

criteria.text: The exact listener PID sets on protected ports 4001 and 4096 are unchanged during foreground startup and after teardown.
criteria.test_id: holds real API/engine health, preserves protected listeners, refuses unrelated PIDs, and tears down

criteria.text: Down refuses a PID whose command does not carry the sandbox path and leaves that unrelated process alive.
criteria.test_id: refuses to stop a PID that does not belong to the sandbox

criteria.text: Down cleanly ends the foreground holder, removes the sandbox directory, and leaves ports 4097 and 4098 free.
criteria.test_id: holds real API/engine health, preserves protected listeners, refuses unrelated PIDs, and tears down

criteria.text: After readiness, the sandbox records the sole 4097 listener only when its executable is this worktree's built fork; after a forced API exit, down terminates that exact surviving engine PID and frees 4097.
criteria.test_id: holds real API/engine health, preserves protected listeners, refuses unrelated PIDs, and tears down

criteria.text: Engine fallback cleanup fails closed when the current 4097 listener PID differs from the recorded PID or the recorded PID's executable is not this sandbox's built fork.
criteria.test_id: refuses an engine listener whose PID differs from the recorded engine; refuses a recorded engine PID whose executable is not the built fork
